baseline_definition_rows.definition: Return a copy of the current grid for every action.
Use the first changing construction row per action and require matching action data.

field_principles.abstention_rows: Abstention rows distinguish missing predictions from wrong predictions.
field_principles.arc_engine_quality_evaluable_score: Evaluability requires a real complete held-out three-arm comparison.
field_principles.arc_engine_quality_positive_score: Positive credit requires paired error improvement over both controls without coverage loss.
field_principles.arc_live_envelope_audit_complete_score: Completion covers either a full audit or a terminal absence search.
field_principles.baseline_definition_rows: Frozen control definitions prevent a post-result baseline change.
field_principles.bootstrap_interval_rows: Grouped intervals quantify improvement without treating episodes as independent cells.
field_principles.construction_transition_rows: Construction membership fixes what the engine could observe.
field_principles.coverage_rows: Coverage rows prevent selective prediction from looking accurate.
field_principles.development_fixture_used_for_quality: Only real live attempts can support the quality result.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time shows that the audit process ran.
field_principles.engine_hash_replay_rows: Engine hashes bind scores to exact executable bytes.
field_principles.engine_score_rows: Engine rows record every scored prediction and failure.
field_principles.envelope_eligibility_rows: One terminal decision per record exposes every exclusion.
field_principles.envelope_hash_replay_rows: Envelope replay detects metadata drift without a hash cycle.
field_principles.envelope_inventory_rows: The full inventory prevents silent selection-denominator changes.
field_principles.environment_hash_replay_rows: Environment hashes bind the producer runtime receipt.
field_principles.factory_hash_replay_rows: Factory hashes bind the evidence to the shipped constructor.
field_principles.field_principles: A reason for each field makes the evidence contract reviewable.
field_principles.game_source_inspected: Producer evidence is sufficient and game source is out of scope.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: The first failed check carries exact expected and observed values.
field_principles.heldout_transition_rows: Held-out membership fixes the transfer population before scoring.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A class-specific terminal prefix supports unambiguous automation.
field_principles.inert_control_rows: Identity rows quantify credit available from predicting no change.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate separates frozen replay from generation and service use.
field_principles.leakage_check_rows: Explicit checks show that held-out answers stayed outside construction.
field_principles.level_claimed: Transition quality does not prove level completion.
field_principles.manifest_hash_replay_rows: Manifest replay verifies the final eligibility marker.
field_principles.missing_target_rows: Missing targets remain explicit and receive no imputed score.
field_principles.paired_metric_rows: Paired errors retain each held-out transition as evidence.
field_principles.per_transition_rows: Sufficient statistics permit independent metric recomputation.
field_principles.policy_hash_replay_rows: Policy hashes bind the evidence to live routing code.
field_principles.pre_engine_control_rows: The shipped pre-induction rule bounds value added by induction.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact preflight values keep missing evidence from becoming a measurement.
field_principles.prompt_hash_replay_rows: Prompt hashes bind synthesis to the original request bytes.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes grouped resampling reproducible.
field_principles.read_only_enforcement_receipt: Child probes show that external effects were unavailable during scoring.
field_principles.registry_updated: A read-only audit must not alter the solve registry.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A timing-free digest detects scientific-content drift.
field_principles.route_influence_rows: Per-row differences show when induction changes the pre-engine prediction.
field_principles.rows: Aggregate metric rows keep construction and held-out results separate.
field_principles.scorer_hash_replay_rows: Scorer hashes fix the producer's quality surface.
field_principles.selected_envelope_hash: The envelope digest identifies the selected producer transaction.
field_principles.selection_rule_rows: Frozen chronological rules prevent quality-based envelope choice.
field_principles.solve_claimed: Engine quality does not prove a game solve.
field_principles.solve_provenance_applicable: Transition prediction has no solve provenance to assess.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Source digests bind the result to exact immutable inputs.
field_principles.source_disagreement_rows: Contradictory producer claims remain visible instead of being reconciled silently.
field_principles.split_manifest_hash: A digest detects any later split or membership change.
field_principles.split_manifest_rows: Every kept or duplicate row remains visible in the frozen split.
field_principles.submitted_to_leaderboard: Local replay is not an external submission.
field_principles.transition_hash_replay_rows: Transition hashes bind ordered observations and targets.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class prevents blocked or null work from reading as positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False separates observation scoring from environment control.
